systemic_contagion_rules.telemetry_signal: SPREAD_BRENT_WTI: $3.41 (3.67% of Brent) | US_SPR_STOCKS: 282,184 k bbl (YoY: -31.11%)

systemic_contagion_rules.media_claim_bias: Market summaries frequently interpret headline 6-currency DXY movements as reflecting neutral broader dollar conditions.
systemic_contagion_rules.ground_truth_reality: Liquidity indicators remain in balanced territory; SOFR-EFFR spread is moderate (4.00 bps) and Fed Broad Dollar index (122.65, YoY: +1.76%) aligns with non-stress historical baselines.

systemic_contagion_rules.telemetry_signal: CHOKE_HORMUZ: 2 vessels/day (-97.8% vs 2023 Base) | CHOKE_TURKISH_STRAITS: -40.7% vs 2023 Base
systemic_contagion_rules.media_claim_bias: Diplomatic statements and headline reporting generally emphasize corridor continuity and stabilization efforts.
systemic_contagion_rules.ground_truth_reality: Pronounced multi-corridor transit deceleration; CHOKE_HORMUZ contracted by -97.8% vs 2023 baseline, with 3 primary global chokepoints simultaneously showing shifts exceeding -30% (Hormuz: 2 vessels/day, -97.8% vs 2023 Base; Turkish Straits: -40.7% vs 2023 Base). Observed commercial flows appear increasingly shaped by specialized operational parameters, potentially requiring selective routing and convoy coordination rather than routine peacetime transits.

systemic_contagion_rules.media_claim_bias: Trade overviews tend to highlight the immediate dampening effect of direct bilateral technology export controls.
systemic_contagion_rules.ground_truth_reality: Calculated technology supply chain friction; Model 25.14 AI Chip Stress registers 0.583 (ELEVATED_SEMICONDUCTOR_BOTTLENECK) alongside elevated NY Fed GSCPI pressure (1.26 Z-Score). Direct US-to-China chip export changes (-8.42% MoM velocity) alongside sustained Asian import volumes (Taiwan: $6,809,991,106 USD, Korea: $7,156,474,554 USD) may suggest that market participants are exploring alternative routing hubs, which could introduce additional logistics and compliance considerations.

systemic_contagion_rules.telemetry_signal: MODEL_28_4_SPILLOVER: 53 (MODERATE_FRICTION) | Net Deficit: 13.36 mbpd (65.2%) | IL_IR Polarity: -1.00
systemic_contagion_rules.media_claim_bias: Public infrastructure reviews often cite overland pipeline capacity as an adaptable alternative to maritime bottlenecks.
systemic_contagion_rules.ground_truth_reality: Structural overland bypass considerations; Model 28.4 parameters indicate overland pipelines (7.14 mbpd capacity) leave a calculated 13.36 mbpd differential (65.2% of baseline flows of 20.50 mbpd). Under prevailing regional geopolitical polarity (-1.00), infrastructure substitution may require extended operational lead times and alternate transit coordination.

systemic_contagion_rules.telemetry_signal: CHOKE_MALACCA: 258 vessels/day (+31.8% vs 2023 Base) | US_CN Baseline Polarity: -0.65 | NYFED_GSCPI: 1.26 Z-Score
systemic_contagion_rules.media_claim_bias: Regulatory announcements typically frame export licensing regimes primarily through the lens of direct bilateral trade balances.
systemic_contagion_rules.ground_truth_reality: Secondary corridor volume concentration; Malacca daily transits shifted +31.8% vs 2023 Base (258 vessels/day) alongside global logistics friction indicators (1.26 Z-Score). Under bilateral trade realignments (US_CN polarity: -0.65), observed traffic patterns may indicate cargo rerouting via regional transshipment hubs, which could gradually influence port turnaround intervals and intermediate handling costs.

systemic_contagion_rules.media_claim_bias: Financial commentary frequently characterizes precious metals rallies as routine commodity inflation or speculative trading cycles.
systemic_contagion_rules.ground_truth_reality: Monetary hedging considerations and geopolitical risk awareness; Gold/Silver Ratio at 82.2 (Spot Gold: $3,745.76 via The Royal Mint / ECB FX, Silver: $45.56) alongside elevated volatility readings (VIX: 25.46, YoY: +27.30%). This combination tends to indicate that market participants may be placing an emphasis on monetary asset stability and sovereign hedging.
